title: CSCI 631 — Foundations of Computer Vision
subject: Computer Vision
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core components of a computer vision pipeline and explain how they transform raw image data into structured geometric and semantic models.
Apply fundamental image processing techniques, including color conversion, filtering, and feature extraction, to analyze visual patterns and lighting,
Evaluate the impact of environmental factors such as viewpoint, illumination, and occlusion on vision system performance and accuracy.
